feats.title: Deep Gash
feats.description: When you deal ongoing damage that has no damage type to a target as a result of an attack that uses an axe or a pick, the target takes a –2 penalty to saving throws against the ongoing damage.

feats.title: Improved Combat Challenge
feats.description: When an adjacent enemy marked by you shifts or makes an attack that doesn't include you as a target while you are using a shield, you give an adjacent ally a +2 bonus to all defenses until the start of your next turn as an immediate interrupt.

feats.title: Defensive Resilience
feats.description: When you use second wind while you are bloodied, you gain a +1 bonus to all defenses, in addition to the normal bonus for second wind, until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Dirty Fighting
feats.description: You gain a +4 bonus to melee weapon damage rolls against surprised enemies.

feats.title: Distracting Shield
feats.description:
If you hit a foe with an attack granted by your Combat Challenge class feature, the target takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

_Special:_ You must have a shield equipped to benefit from this feat.

feats.title: Dragging Flail
feats.description: Whenever you use a flail to knock an enemy prone, you can also slide that enemy 1 square.

feats.title: Encouraging Shield
feats.description: Your shield bonus also applies to your Will defense.

feats.title: Fighter Weapon Specialization
feats.requirements: One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls when you hit with an attack using a weapon of the style covered by your One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent class feature.

feats.title: Focused Superiority
feats.description: While you are wielding a one-handed weapon, you gain a bonus to damage rolls equal to your Wisdom with opportunity attacks.

feats.title: Forceful Opportunist
feats.requirements: One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
feats.description: Whenever you hit a target with an opportunity attack, you can push the target 1 square and shift into the square the target vacated.

feats.title: Improved Vigor
feats.description: You gain a +1 feat bonus to the number of temporary hit points you gain from using an invigorating power. The bonus increases to 2 at 11th level and 3 at 21st level.

feats.title: Hewing Charge
feats.description: You gain a bonus to damage rolls equal to your Constitution when making charge attacks while using a two-handed weapon.

feats.title: Marked Fury
feats.description: If an adjacent enemy that is marked by you makes an attack that doesn't include you as a target, it takes a penalty to the attack roll equal to either -2 or the number of enemies adjacent to you, whichever is worse. This penalty replaces the normal penalty for having a creature marked.

feats.title: Mobile Challenge
feats.description: After you hit an enemy with a melee basic attack granted by your Combat Challenge class feature, you can shift 1 square.

feats.title: Offensive Resilience
feats.description: When you are bloodied and use second wind, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Polearm Momentum
feats.description: Whenever you use a polearm or a spear attack to push or slide a target 2 or more squares, you can also knock that target prone at the end of the forced movement.

feats.title: Potent Challenge
feats.description:
If you hit a foe with an attack granted by your Combat Challenge class feature, add your Constitution to the damage roll.

_Special:_ This benefit applies only to attacks made with two-handed weapons.

feats.title: Reaping Blade
feats.description: If you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with an attack using a heavy blade, you can shift as a minor action until the end of your current turn.

feats.title: Savage Axe
feats.description: When you hit with an opportunity attack with an axe, you deal extra damage equal to your Constitution.

feats.title: Shield Defense
feats.description: When you hit with a power that requires a shield, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and Reflex until the end of your next turn or until you stop using the shield.

feats.title: Shield Push
feats.description:
If you hit a foe with an attack granted by your Combat Challenge class feature, you push the target 1 square after dealing damage.

_Special:_ You must be using a shield to benefit from this feat.

feats.title: Shielded Resurgence
feats.description: When you use your second wind while you are using a shield, you regain extra hit points equal to your Wisdom, and the bonus to defenses lasts until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Stout Shield
feats.description: Your shield bonus also applies to your Fortitude.

feats.title: Swift Spear
feats.description: When you hit with an opportunity attack with a spear, you can also slide that enemy 1 square to a space adjacent to you.

feats.title: Thunder Hammer
feats.description: When you make an attack using a hammer or a mace that causes the target to become dazed, immobilized, slowed, or stunned, that target takes a –2 penalty to saving throws against any of those conditions.

feats.title: Unbalancing Shield Shove
feats.description: When you hit with an opportunity attack while using a shield, the target grants combat advantage until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Victor's Confidence
feats.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a melee attack, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws until the end of the encounter.

feats.title: Wary Fighter
feats.description: You use your Wisdom instead of your Dexterity when rolling initiative. You also gain a +2 feat bonus to Insight and Perception checks.
